section.title: Overview
section.para: This module lets a P-CSCF authorise media resources in a 5G core directly over the N5 reference point, acting as an Application Function (AF) towards the PCF with the Npcf_PolicyAuthorization service of 3GPP TS 29.514, instead of using Rx (Diameter) towards a PCRF as the ims_qos module does. The mapping of SDP to media components follows TS 29.513.

N5_create() is called in the reply route of an INVITE, UPDATE or PRACK that completes an SDP offer/answer. The first call for a dialog and direction creates an Individual Application Session Context (HTTP POST to /npcf-policyauthorization/v1/app-sessions), containing the UE's IPv4 address, the AF application identifier, the media components and the event subscription; later calls update it (PATCH). When the dialog ends (BYE, failure or expiry), the application session is deleted (POST .../delete). An answer of 404 to the delete is accepted, as the PCF may already have removed it.

The PCF reports events with POST {notifUri}/notify and requests the termination of an application session, e.g. when the PDU session is released, with POST {notifUri}/terminate (TS 29.514 clauses 4.2.5.2 and 4.2.5.3). These callbacks are received with the nghttp2 module and passed to N5_notification(); a termination releases the dialog, as ims_qos does on an Rx Abort-Session-Request. The notifUri given to the PCF identifies the dialog and direction, so callbacks need no other state.

The callback path identifies a dialog by its hash entry and id, which are predictable: the nghttp2 listener must be reachable only from the 5G core's service-based interface network (bind it with the nghttp2 listen_addr parameter and filter it), as Diameter peers are restricted for Rx.

Requests to the PCF use HTTP/2 with prior knowledge (cleartext h2c) by default. A request that fails on a reused connection without any response, e.g. because the producer closed the idle connection with GOAWAY, is retried once on a new connection (RFC 9113 clause 6.8).

If the 5G core enforces OAuth2 (3GPP TS 29.500 clause 6.7), set oauth: the module then registers the P-CSCF with the NRF as an NF instance (NFRegister, then heartbeats) from a dedicated process, obtains access tokens with AccessTokenReq (TS 29.510) and sends them as bearer tokens to the PCF. They are sent synchronously by the SIP worker that executes the reply route, bounded by http_timeout.

section.title: &kamailio; Modules
section.para:
The following modules must be loaded before this module:
tm.
ims_dialog - the dialog must be created (dialog flag set) before the request is relayed.
nghttp2 - to receive the PCF's callbacks.

section.title: External Libraries or Applications
section.para:
The following libraries or applications must be installed before running &kamailio; with this module loaded:
libcurl with HTTP/2 (nghttp2) support.
libjansson.

section.title: pcf_uri (str)
section.para: Scheme, address and port of the PCF's Npcf_PolicyAuthorization service. Mandatory.

section.title: notif_uri (str)
section.para: Base URI at which the PCF reaches this P-CSCF's nghttp2 listener. The module appends /<dialog id>-<o|t> for each application session. Mandatory.

section.title: af_app_id (str)
section.para: Value of afAppId.

section.title: dnn (str)
section.para: Value of dnn, if set (e.g. ims).

section.title: events (str)
section.para: Comma-separated AfEvent values subscribed in evSubsc (TS 29.514 clause 5.6.3.3), the N5 counterparts of the Rx Specific-Action values a P-CSCF requests. Empty: no subscription.

section.title: release_headers (str)
section.para: Extra headers for the BYEs sent when the PCF terminates an application session.

section.title: http_timeout (int)
section.para: Timeout in milliseconds for connecting to the PCF and for each request.

section.title: http2 (int)
section.para: If 1, requests use HTTP/2 with prior knowledge; if 0, libcurl's default (HTTP/1.1, or h2 negotiated over TLS).

section.title: audio_default_bandwidth (int)
section.para: Bandwidth in kbit/s for marBwUl/marBwDl of an audio stream whose SDP has no b=AS line.

section.title: video_default_bandwidth (int)
section.para: As audio_default_bandwidth, for video streams.

section.title: authorize_video_flow (int)
section.para: If 0, video streams are not included in the media components.

section.title: include_rtcp_fd (int)
section.para: If 1, each media component gets a second sub-component with the RTCP flows (port + 1).

section.title: oauth (int)
section.para: If 1, use OAuth2 towards the PCF: register with the NRF and send access tokens. Requires nrf_uri and nf_instance_id.

section.title: nrf_uri (str)
section.para: Scheme, address and port of the NRF (NFManagement and access token services).

section.title: nf_instance_id (str)
section.para: NF instance id (a UUID) under which the P-CSCF registers with the NRF and requests tokens.

section.title: nf_type (str)
section.para: NF type registered with the NRF and used as nfType in AccessTokenReq.

section.title: nf_ipv4 (str)
section.para: IPv4 address put in the registered NF profile (ipv4Addresses), if set.

section.title: heartbeat_interval (int)
section.para: Heartbeat interval in seconds offered at registration; the interval granted by the NRF is used.
Creates or updates the application session for the dialog of this reply. Use in an onreply_route of INVITE, UPDATE or PRACK.

listitem.para: direction - orig if the UE is the caller, term if it is the callee. It selects whose SDP holds the UE's address; requests from either end of the dialog are handled.
subscription_id (optional) - the served user: imsi-... is sent as supi; a tel or SIP URI with a number, or msisdn-..., as gpsi.

section.para: Returns 1 on success (201 for a creation, 200/204 for an update), -1 otherwise.

example.title: N5_create usage

section.para: Handles a callback from the PCF received by the nghttp2 module. Returns 1 for a termination (the dialog is being released), 2 for an event notification, -2 if the dialog no longer exists and -1 if the path is not an N5 callback of this module.
